Basic chat completion with a single user message

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"temperature\":0}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(req: _req)
debugPrint(result.choices())
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].message().content() as Any)
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].finishReason() as Any)
debugPrint(result.usage()?.totalTokens() as Any)
debugPrint(result.model())
```
